label: A channel
gives: messages come in and go out through it

label: A place knowledge is kept
gives: what the business knows is searched and read in it

label: A calendar
gives: free times of a person are found and meetings are put in, moved and cancelled; it tells what became of them

label: A booking service
gives: a person's booking link is given out; it tells when somebody booked, moved or cancelled, naming them by their address

label: A recorder of calls
gives: calls are recorded and their transcript or recording is given; it tells when one is ready

label: A reader of documents
gives: files given to a case are read page by page, and agents and steps find what is in them, with the page it is on
example: the documents connection that comes with the platform
